doc.title: Jane Ira Bloom interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 3, 1998

title: Photography and Tai Chi
summary: Her hobbies and how Tai Chi relates to playing.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Photography. I’ve been in to black & white photography since I was teenager and I kind of re-discovered it this past couple of years. So a lot of time I spend in the darkroom.

Tai Chi. I practice Tai Chi and I’ve been studying Tai Chi for two years and I find it very complementary to things I think about musically. And again it gets in line with my feeling about the physicalness of things that I feel, you know the old sound body, sound mind, you know, when I’m physically aware I feel mentally aware too for playing and clear, empty, you know what I mean, to play. So I think there’s a relationship between physical disciplines and musical too.
Good advice also. Think we’ll ever see one of your photos on one of your CDs?
